sloka: ददौ खड्गं महादीप्तं चन्द्रहासमिति श्रुतम् ।आयुषश्चावशेषं च स्थित्वा भूतपतिस्तदा ।। ७.१६.४५ ॥
transliteration: dadau khaḍgaṁ mahādīptaṁ candrahāsamiti śrutam ।āyuṣaścāvaśeṣaṁ ca sthitvā bhūtapatistadā ।। 7.16.45 ॥

translations.english: Then, Lord Shiva, the lord of beings, granted him the greatly radiant sword known as Chandrahāsa, and also the remainder of his life.
